latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of crypto-exit-rule-drafter

- Enables users to define specific, written exit rules for their crypto positions.
- Guides users through clarifying position details, risk tolerance, and investment thesis.
- Produces two concrete exit rules: price-based (stop-loss) and fundamental-change-based.
- Includes a review trigger and commitment statement to encourage disciplined execution.
- Designed for prompt-only usage, requiring no portfolio integration.
